item.title: Inmarsat Maritime, SK telink Expand South Korea Maritime Digitalization Partnership
item.summary: Inmarsat Maritime, a subsidiary of Viasat, has partnered with South Korean telecommunications provider SK telink to promote maritime digitalization in the nation’s shipping sector. This collaboration aims to enhance support for shipowners through the introduction of NexusWave services, which offer next-generation connectivity to improve operational efficiency, resilience, and the welfare of crew members.
